patch.objective: Resilience and recovery: high availability (load balancing vs. clustering), site considerations (hot, cold, warm, geographic dispersion), platform diversity, multi-cloud systems, continuity of operations, capacity planning (people, technology, infrastructure); testing (tabletop exercises, fail over, simulation, parallel processing); backups (onsite/offsite, frequency, encryption, snapshots, recovery, replication, journaling); power (generators, uninterruptible power supply (UPS))
